newsitem.title: USA: Exar Corp reduces headcount by 7 percent.
newsitem.headline: Exar Corp reduces headcount by 7 percent.

text.p: Exar Corp Friday said it had reduced its headcount by approximately 30 employees, or seven percent of the company's work force.
In a statement, the company said most of the reductions occurred in manufacturing and operations areas.
In addition, Exar said it plans to operate with a limited staff during the weeks of November 25, December 23 and December 30, for a total of nine business days, excluding holidays.
"Together with other cost saving measures, the company is attempting to bring expenses in line with revenues," the company said.
"The current industry downturn has resulted in a weak and unpredictable demand for Exar's products," George Wells, president and chief executive said.
Exar designs, develops and markets system-level analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits for the communication consumer and computer markets.
